biggest_catch: Credit posts only if the referred customer actually completes a new propane tank installation; a referral that just gets a quote or signs up without a tank set earns nothing.
catches: Referral reward requires a completed new propane tank set by the referred customer: $50 for a 120-gallon tank set, $100 for 250 gallons or larger.
Credit is applied to the referrer's Forward Energy account only after installation is complete.
Duplicate referrals go to the earliest entry received; some exceptions may apply.
All accounts must meet Forward Energy credit approval criteria.
Reward is an account credit only (propane service spending), framed as savings on planned energy spending.

steps: Fill out the $50-$100 Referral Form at forwardenergy.com with your contact info and your friend's.
Your referral signs up and completes a new propane tank set installation.
Once installation is complete, $50 (120-gal tank) or $100 (250+-gal tank) credit posts to your Forward Energy account.
timing: Credit applied to your account once the referral's tank installation is complete; duplicate referrals awarded to earliest entry.
